explanation: The theorem is stated in terms of `localCyclotomicCharacter`. This is the library's own definition: grepping Mathlib for that name finds nothing. In this area Mathlib has only `cyclotomicCharacter` and its lemmas `cyclotomicCharacter.spec` and `cyclotomicCharacter.toZModPow` (Mathlib/NumberTheory/Cyclotomic/CyclotomicCharacter.lean). The current proof uses `cyclotomicCharacter.spec` as one ingredient. I found no Mathlib result that restricts the image of the cyclotomic character (mod 8 or otherwise) when -2 is a square in the base field. The library's proof is an explicit computation with a primitive 8th root of unity, so it is not a one- or two-line consequence of a single Mathlib lemma.
